sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.
📖 LEARNED: Night Hunting (Level 1). Hunting at night is not hunting blind. It is hunting by ear, by smell, by patience.
📖 LEARNED: Shield Wall (Level 1). Shoulder to shoulder in the wilds, you brace as one. While an ally fights beside you, blows that reach you land softer — the line holds together or not at all.
📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
📖 Your old life taught you things. 14 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 2). Set the loop at head height for the target species. Anchor it solid. Camouflage the wire.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 6 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Dieter Jefferson. Bush pilot. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Wedding ring, Trail compass, Lucky Coin, Field suture kit, Home key. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong
A man, maybe 50s, with a gap-toothed grin: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
